title: feat(milestone): add --include-descendants to milestone list
description:
## Description

Running `glab milestone list --group` only listed milestones defined directly on that group.
There was no way to view milestones from subgroups or descendant projects.

I added the `--include-descendants` flag to `glab milestone list`.
When used with `--group`, glab now fetches milestones from all subgroups and descendant projects.

Because results can now span multiple namespaces, I added an Owner column to the table output when `--include-descendants` is enabled.
This column helps users see which subgroup or project owns each milestone.

A few decisions on the behavior:
1. `--include-descendants` is mutually exclusive with `--project`. Project milestones do not have descendants, so combining them returns an error.
2. The Owner column appears only when `--include-descendants` is set. Standard group and project listings keep their original table format.
3. The Owner column shows the subgroup or project path from the milestone web URL. It falls back to `group/<id>` or `project/<id>` if the URL is unavailable.
4. JSON output includes `group_id` and `project_id` fields for scripting.

## Related Issues

Closes #8709

## How has this been tested?

I tested the mutual exclusivity check by hand using a built `glab` binary:

```shell
$ glab milestone list --project 123 --include-descendants
   ERROR  
  if any flags in the group [project include-descendants] are set none of the 
  others can be; [include-descendants project] were all set.                  
```

I added unit tests covering flag wiring, mock verification for `IncludeDescendents`, table output with the Owner column, and `--show-id`.
I also added tests for mutual exclusivity with `--project`, JSON output, and milestone owner parsing edge cases.

Checks I ran locally on the changed package:

```shell
$ go test -count=1 ./internal/commands/milestone/list/...
ok  	gitlab.com/gitlab-org/cli/internal/commands/milestone/list	0.023s
```

```shell
$ go run ./scripts/comment-overlap -threshold 1.0 -max-findings 0 internal/commands/milestone/list/list.go internal/commands/milestone/list/list_test.go
# 0 findings across 2 files
```

I also regenerated the command documentation with `make gen-docs`.

The rest runs in the pipeline.

Implemented with AI assistance; I reviewed and tested the changes.
